# REST API

Base path `/api/v1`. JSON, snake_case, Discord API v10 object shapes plus Discordy extras. IDs are Snowflakes and permission sets are 64-bit integers, both serialized as decimal strings. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` or `Authorization: Bot <token>`. The machine-readable description is `openapi/discordy.yaml`.

## Rate limits

Responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`, `X-RateLimit-Reset-After`, `X-RateLimit-Bucket`. A 429 response also carries `Retry-After`.

## Errors

Errors use the envelope `{ "code": int, "message": string, "errors"?: object }`.

| Code | Name | HTTP | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `GENERAL_ERROR` | 500 | General error. |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | You are being rate limited. |
| 10002 | `UNKNOWN_APPLICATION` | 404 | Unknown application. |
| 10003 | `UNKNOWN_CHANNEL` | 404 | Unknown channel. |
| 10004 | `UNKNOWN_GUILD` | 404 | Unknown guild. |
| 10006 | `UNKNOWN_INVITE` | 404 | Unknown invite. |
| 10007 | `UNKNOWN_MEMBER` | 404 | Unknown member. |
| 10008 | `UNKNOWN_MESSAGE` | 404 | Unknown message. |
| 10011 | `UNKNOWN_ROLE` | 404 | Unknown role. |
| 10013 | `UNKNOWN_USER` | 404 | Unknown user. |
| 10014 | `UNKNOWN_EMOJI` | 404 | Unknown emoji. |
| 10015 | `UNKNOWN_WEBHOOK` | 404 | Unknown webhook. |
| 10026 | `UNKNOWN_BAN` | 404 | Unknown ban. |
| 10057 | `UNKNOWN_GUILD_TEMPLATE` | 404 | Unknown guild template. |
| 10062 | `UNKNOWN_INTERACTION` | 404 | Unknown interaction. |
| 10063 | `UNKNOWN_APPLICATION_COMMAND` | 404 | Unknown application command. |
| 40001 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Unauthorized. Provide a valid token and try again. |
| 40002 | `VERIFICATION_REQUIRED` | 403 | You need to verify your account in order to perform this action. |
| 50001 | `MISSING_ACCESS` | 403 | Missing access. |
| 50013 | `MISSING_PERMISSIONS` | 403 | You lack permissions to perform that action. |
| 50035 | `INVALID_FORM_BODY` | 400 | Invalid form body. |
| 50160 | `DELIVERY_MODE_CONFLICT` | 409 | Discordy: the channel uses a non-standard delivery mode; send over gateway op 20 or op 22. |

## Delivery modes

| Mode | Strictness |
| --- | --- |
| `standard` | 0 |
| `ephemeral` | 1 |
| `p2p` | 2 |

- Guild channels: the channel's `delivery_mode`, set by members with MANAGE_CHANNELS.
- DMs and group DMs: the strictest of each participant's per-chat override, falling back to their `default_delivery_mode`.
- `ephemeral` is rejected (400) for guild channels viewable by more than 100 members; `p2p` for guild channels and group DMs with more than 10 members.
- `POST /channels/{id}/messages` returns 409 with code 50160 when the effective mode is not `standard`.

## Objects

### Activity

A user activity as stored and fanned out. The gateway sanitises client activities (PRESENCE_UPDATE): only the fields below are kept, unknown fields (including `application_id`) are dropped, and a violation closes the socket with 4002.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | Required, non-empty, at most 128 characters. |
| `type` | `integer` | ActivityType, 0..5. At most one activity per presence may be type 4 (custom status). |
| `url?` | `?string` | At most 512 characters. |
| `created_at?` | `integer` | Unix milliseconds. |
| `timestamps?` | `ActivityTimestamps` |  |
| `details?` | `?string` | At most 128 characters. |
| `state?` | `?string` | At most 128 characters. |
| `emoji?` | `?ActivityEmoji` |  |

### ActivityEmoji

Emoji of a custom status.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `id?` | `Snowflake` | Custom emoji id. |
| `animated?` | `boolean` |  |

### ActivityTimestamps

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start?` | `integer` |  |
| `end?` | `integer` |  |

### AllowedMentions

### GuildNotificationSettings

The current user's notification settings for one guild, or for their DMs when guild_id is null (Discord's user guild settings). A channel override beats the guild level, which beats the guild's default_message_notifications. A muted guild mutes all its channels. Private to the user, synced to every session.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `guild_id` | `?Snowflake` | null for direct messages and group DMs. |
| `message_notifications` | `0 or 1 or 2 or null` | 0 all messages, 1 only @mentions, 2 nothing. null inherits (the guild level for a channel override, the guild's default_message_notifications for the guild). |
| `suppress_everyone` | `boolean` | Suppress @everyone and @here. |
| `suppress_roles` | `boolean` | Suppress all role @mentions. |
| `muted` | `boolean` |  |

### MessageReference

Reference to another message (reply, forward, crosspost). type 0 = DEFAULT (reply), 1 = FORWARD. A FORWARD reference requires message_id and channel_id; the server copies the source message into message_snapshots at send time and the reference is informational afterwards (the viewer may lack access to the source channel). On a PIN (type 6) message, message_id is the pinned message. On a THREAD_CREATED (type 18) message, message_id is absent and channel_id is the created thread.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type?` | `integer` | MessageReferenceType: 0 DEFAULT (reply), 1 FORWARD. |
| `message_id?` | `Snowflake` |  |
| `channel_id?` | `Snowflake` |  |
| `guild_id?` | `Snowflake` |  |
| `fail_if_not_exists?` | `boolean` |  |

| `index_building?` | `boolean` | True while the search index is being (re)built from stored history; results may be incomplete. |

### UserPreferences

Client preferences that follow the account across devices (client#123). Sparse: a key is present only once the user (or a first-run migration) set it; clients fall back to their defaults for missing keys. As a PATCH value the object is merged key by key. Device-specific settings (audio and video devices, volumes, keybinds, window state, desktop notification toggle, taskbar flash) are not stored here.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accent?` | `"iris" or "aurora" or "ember" or "rose" or "citrine" or "sky"` | Accent colour preset. |
| `reduce_motion?` | `boolean` |  |
| `font_scale?` | `number` | Chat font scale. |
| `show_avatars_in_compact?` | `boolean` |  |
| `link_previews?` | `boolean` | Show previews (embeds) of links in messages. |
| `saturation?` | `number` | Colour saturation of the interface, 1 is full colour (accessibility). |
| `role_colors?` | `"name" or "dot" or "hidden"` | How role colours show on member names: tint the name, a dot beside it, or not at all. |
| `link_underline?` | `boolean` | Always underline links in messages. |
| `message_spacing?` | `integer` | Space in pixels between message groups. |
| `high_contrast?` | `boolean` | Increase contrast of text and borders. |
| `animate_gifs?` | `boolean` | Play GIFs automatically; when off they play on hover. |
| `animate_emoji?` | `boolean` | Animate custom emoji automatically. |
| `animate_stickers?` | `boolean` | Animate stickers automatically. |
| `tts_read_aloud?` | `boolean` | Allow the /tts command and read text-to-speech messages aloud. |
| `tts_rate?` | `number` | Speech rate of text-to-speech playback, 1 is normal. |
| `notify_only_mentions?` | `boolean` |  |
| `notify_sounds?` | `boolean` | Master switch for notification sounds. |
| `sound_toggles?` | `map of boolean` | Per-sound switches under notify_sounds; a missing entry means on. |
| `ringtone?` | `string` |  |
| `skin_tone?` | `string` | Skin tone modifier of the emoji picker; empty for the default. |
| `recent_reactions?` | `array of object` | Recently used reaction emoji, most recent first. |

## Request and response bodies

### AckRequest

POST /channels/{id}/messages/{mid}/ack body.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `manual?` | `boolean` | When true the read marker is set to exactly this message, even backwards (Mark Unread). Without it the marker only moves forward. |

Updates metadata of one attachment already owned by this message. Omitted properties are unchanged; description null or blank clears alt text. Files, filenames, IDs and URLs are immutable. Only the author may edit attachment metadata.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `Snowflake` |  |
| `description?` | `?string` | Trimmed alt text; null or blank clears it. |

### CreateMessageRequest

POST /channels/{id}/messages body. allowed_mentions.replied_user=false replies without pinging the replied-to author. Returns 409 (code 50160) when the effective delivery mode is not standard. A message_reference with type 1 (FORWARD) forwards message_id from channel_id: the caller needs VIEW_CHANNEL + READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY on the source and SEND_MESSAGES (+ ATTACH_FILES when the source has attachments) on the target; content is the optional added comment and may be empty. Forwards from or to non-standard (ephemeral/P2P) channels answer 409 (50160).

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content?` | `string` |  |
| `nonce?` | `string` |  |
| `tts?` | `boolean` | Read aloud by recipients with TTS enabled. Requires SEND_TTS_MESSAGES in addition to normal send permission; a disallowed true value returns 403. Stored and returned on messages and gateway events. |
| `embeds?` | `array of Embed` |  |
| `allowed_mentions?` | `AllowedMentions` |  |
| `message_reference?` | `MessageReference` |  |
| `components?` | `array of MessageComponent` |  |
| `attachments?` | `array of AttachmentReference` |  |
| `flags?` | `integer` | MessageFlags bit set. Only SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS (4096) is honoured for users; other bits are dropped. |

### PasskeyRenameRequest

Rename one of the authenticated user's passkeys. The name is trimmed and must contain 1–64 Unicode characters without control characters. Credential material and MFA state are unchanged.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  |

| `password` | `string` |  |

### RefreshRequest

POST /auth/refresh body.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `refresh_token` | `string` | Opaque 256-bit token, base64url. |
| `request_id?` | `string (uuid)` | Optional random UUID saved durably with the current refresh token before sending. Retrying this exact pair for up to five minutes recovers its immediate unused, unexpired successor in a live session without extending expiry. Keep the UUID until successor credentials are saved, then generate a new UUID for the next rotation. Omission retains strict single-use rotation. |

### ReportListingRequest

Report a currently discoverable guild listing. The server captures only the public listing as evidence. Shares the reporter's 10-per-hour report limit; an existing open report from the same user is idempotent. Filing a report does not automatically remove a listing.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | `"spam" or "harassment" or "hate_speech" or "violence" or "sexual_content" or "self_harm" or "illegal" or "impersonation" or "other"` |  |
| `note?` | `?string` |  |

### WebauthnChallenge

A five-minute, single-use server-side ceremony. Finish requires the same account/session or password-authenticated login ticket.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `challenge_id` | `string (uuid)` |  |
| `publicKey` | `object` | WebAuthn PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON or PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON. Binary members use unpadded base64url. |

### WebauthnLoginFinishRequest

Complete a passkey assertion. The assertion challenge and login ticket are single use, and the credential signature counter is checked.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticket` | `string` |  |
| `challenge_id` | `string (uuid)` |  |
| `credential` | `object` |  |

### WebauthnLoginStartRequest

Begin passkey assertion after the password login returned MFA_REQUIRED.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticket` | `string` |  |
